name: Boundless
detailed_description:
Shirley, a brave young girl, embarks on a solo mission to rescue her robot friend Spark after a surprise attack by cosmic robot pirates. Determined to save her companion, she infiltrates the enemy spaceship—kicking off a fast-paced interstellar platforming adventure.

Core Features

🔸 Story-Driven Adventure

Follow Shirley’s heartfelt journey through a mysterious spacecraft as she braves danger and uncovers secrets in her quest to reunite with Spark.

🔸 Four Themed Levels

Each stage presents unique challenges and visual styles:

A cluttered scrapyard-like warehouse filled with moving machinery

Defense laser corridors requiring precise movement

High-speed interstellar escape sequences

The final showdown against the pirate leader aboard the command bridge

🔸 Progressive Difficulty

Levels grow increasingly complex, introducing new traps, enemies, and mechanics that test your reflexes and problem-solving skills.

🔸 Unique Gadgets & Power-Ups

Unlock tools like the Jetpack for aerial movement and the Magnetic Orb for manipulating metallic objects. These abilities are key to progressing through multi-layered environments.

🔸 Integrated Puzzle Challenges

Each level features cleverly designed puzzles, hidden keys, and secret paths. Progress requires both timing and logic—think fast and move smart.

🔸 Simple Keyboard Controls

Designed for accessibility:

Use C to confirm and interact

Use Arrow Keys to move and navigate menus

Responsive controls optimized for precision platforming

🔸 Stylized Visuals

Low-poly 3D graphics with bold color contrast, bringing a clean and modern sci-fi aesthetic to life.

🔸 Immersive Audio Feedback

In-game sounds dynamically respond to your actions: jumping, landing, activating traps, or triggering mechanisms—all heightening immersion.

🔸 No Microtransactions

Enjoy a full, standalone single-player experience. No paywalls, ads, or in-game purchases.

🔸 Estimated Playtime

3–6 hours for a regular playthrough. Additional time required for full completion.
